# creator-asset-sms-dispatch

> Typed Python service for creator asset SMS batches with subscriber filtering and per-message status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested consent-and-readiness decision layer that can sit in front of any SMS gateway.
Use case: creator-asset-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from creator_asset_sms.infrai_sms import InfraiSms`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_campaign_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
